annotations.title: Posts from people saying they're hiring

description: Posts from people saying they're hiring. For "who's posting that they're hiring React developers?", "any startups hiring remote designers?". Public posts from people saying they're hiring, from Hacker News (the monthly Who is hiring? thread), Mastodon and Bluesky, newest first, each with a link to the post. The person posting is often the hiring manager. Also gives a ready search link for X.

what.description: Job title or field, for example "nurse" or "software engineer".

where.description: A city, region, postcode or country, for example Birmingham, Austin, TX or remote.
